summary: Dr. Reddy's Laboratories Ltd. filed a Form 6-K (report of foreign private issuer) disclosing that the USFDA completed a Pre-Approval Inspection (PAI) and GMP inspection at its FTO-SEZ Process Unit-02 in Srikakulam, Andhra Pradesh, from July 20-29, 2026. The company received a Form 483 with three observations and will address them within the stipulated timeline. This is a routine regulatory update, not a special situation. No deal terms, corporate action, or strategic review is involved.
